_comment: ghostdev default settings — `bin/orkest-init` (or `ghostdev-update`) reconciles this into the live .claude/settings.json; hand-copying it also works. Hook commands resolve bin/ from $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR so a session opened in a subfolder still runs them. Hooks run in warn-mode by default; set env ORKEST_HOOK_BLOCK=1 to opt into block-mode globally, or set 'block-mode: true' in an individual IMPL header for per-IMPL block-mode. Prefer bash? Swap each `pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/X.ps1"` for `bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/X.sh"`; update keeps either form.
_represent_hook_example: Optional: regenerate the Represent scene on every Edit/Write (needs `dotnet tool install --global ghostdev-represent` first — see GUIDE.md § Visualize state). Add a PostToolUse hook: "PostToolUse": [ { "matcher": "Edit|Write", "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "pwsh -NoProfile -File bin/ghostdev-represent.ps1 --folder docs/ --mermaid --out .represent/" } ] } ]. Costs a dotnet invocation per Edit/Write, so it's left out by default.
